variants.title: A · 环形作品展厅
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: approval concept art for a NEW interactive 3D "My Works" destination scene in an existing personal portfolio website, NOT an implemented page.
Input image 1 is the actual current day room; input image 2 the actual night room. Both are STYLE / MATERIAL / architectural DNA references only. Design a different spatial environment related to that room, not a rearrangement of its desk and chair.
Shared design DNA: midnight-blue lacquer panels, substantial smoothly rounded silver metal framing, pale ceramic surfaces, finely detailed but buildable industrial joints, bronze/rust upholstery, smoked glass, warm amber light concentrated in small fixtures, elegant retro-futuristic studio miniatures. Dense intentional object design, coherent thickness, extremely smooth high quality curves and controlled surface microtexture. NO people/avatars. NO black void outside; finish an enclosing architectural backdrop and adjacent exterior terrace with depth so camera movement will not reveal edges.
Image is a polished landscape architectural concept BOARD with 80% of the image one large hero render, bottom 20% three small distinct sequential camera thumbnails separated by clean margins, depicting current reference room -> connection passage -> proposed new gallery. Thin warm-white editorial border, a small top-left concept letter and Chinese name only, no paragraph text or giant UI. Main hero: slightly elevated 3/4 cutaway view with strong depth and visible interior, a complete clickable scene filling most of frame, all architecture and support platform visible.
Works have not been supplied: show original abstract form studies / neutral placeholder exhibit graphics ONLY, no fabricated personal projects, brand logos, author names, client names or awards. Six clear independently selectable display bays/pedestals, labeled only 01 through 06 if needed, plus thoughtful smaller independent instruments and props. Abstract artwork must be clearly visual placeholders.
Render quality: refined Blender/Cycles architectural maquette, cinematic art direction, sharp silhouette, convincing glass reflections and soft contact shadows, physically believable light. Design for eventual real-time 3D implementation, no impossible floating architecture, no hologram HUD clutter, no endless neon strips. This stage is concept approval only.

Text (verbatim) at top left: "A · 环形作品展厅".
Specific scene: a sculptural oval pavilion adjacent to the studio, a continuous C-shaped silver canopy / thick frame around six dark-blue recessed display bays on the back half. A graceful low open front allows camera access. A central low circular kinetic exhibition plinth with a silver folded sculpture; four smaller plinths at staggered heights, two framed image panels, three detailed lens-like spotlights, a single rust-colored curved bench, a side curation control desk, sculptural ceramic planters and small archive trays. A short glazed connecting bridge enters at left rear and physically links to the existing studio architecture. Built-in warm niches and amber pools of light contrast with evening blue glazing, cozy rich blue hour rather than pitch dark. Exterior finished stepped silver terrace and layered distant rounded pavilions, warm lanterns. Make arrangement rich, legible, spatially composed, not a shopping mall, not a gaming spaceship.
Camera storyboard bottom: source room exterior medium view -> backward curved dolly along its orbital deck toward the short connector -> settle in the new oval exhibit pavilion. Depict a smooth spatially continuous camera route, not teleportation or zoom through a screen.

Text (verbatim) at top left: "B · 日光玻璃长廊".
Specific scene: an elongated gently bending glass gallery with a sophisticated asymmetric silver ribbed canopy and broad rounded panoramic windows, attached to the same futuristic studio complex. Bright daytime. Sun enters from upper right at a clear oblique angle, glazing mullions cast articulated long shadow bands over warm pale terrazzo inset in a midnight-blue and brushed-metal floor. Six independent exhibit stations alternate between framed artwork surfaces, small smoked-glass vitrines, and exquisite tabletop silver sculpture studies. An island display reading table with articulated sheet holders, a rust leather linear bench, hanging plant pots, floor lanterns that are dim in daylight, a rotating specimen plinth, little tactile control wheels and an archive trolley. Planting and architectural layers fill exterior views, pale distant city silhouette in atmospheric depth, no empty black background. Strong daylight tactile highlights but preserve artwork visibility, match reference material family. The long side is opened as a dollhouse cutaway, emphasize depth and a graceful curving circulation path, not an ordinary office corridor.
Camera storyboard bottom: source studio room from reference -> camera turns sideways through a rounded EXISTING-COMPLEX connecting threshold, its silver frame briefly naturally occluding the view -> daylight gallery view opens, camera smoothly settles in an elevated readable exhibit view. Transition proposal contains a new connector to be designed after approval, not a claim the current room already has a door.

Text (verbatim) at top left: "C · 层叠创作档案室".
Specific scene: an intimate compact two-tier creative archive atelier, a wide softly stepped crescent floor and substantial rounded blue-and-silver shell. Back wall made of beautifully detailed offset rounded cabinetry, six generous open display alcoves as the actual project destinations, with bronze pivots, small pulls, smoked glass doors slid to one side, discreet number tabs. Each alcove contains a different neutral abstract specimen, fold-out blank art folio or suspended framed placeholder. Front center: one sculptural oval curatorial table with a mechanical carousel holding several independent upright folio panels, tactile archive index wheels and a hinged desk lamp. Secondary objects: cylindrical archive canisters, carefully stacked art books, a small lens viewing station, drafting ruler, sculptural plants, a rust upholstered reading perch. A short broad ramp connects the two shallow display levels, no vast tall library or ladders. Dense, artistic, warm, tactile and purposeful with adequate negative space around clickable works. Twilight through a high panoramic corner window with blue-gray outdoor terrace architecture visible; shelves have warm 2700K spotlit pools, small amber globe lamps and subtle glints of polished metal. No giant glowing wall screens or sci-fi holograms.
Camera storyboard bottom: original room -> gently sidestep past the tall reference display cabinet and follow a shallow silver-lined connecting arch, smooth quarter orbit rather than a hard cut -> settle into archive overview with central rotating folio table foreground. Make second scene feel like the studio owner's private curated collection without inventing biography.
